zh.title: 中立野怪登场
items: 棋盘中间的中立列会刷新 8–12 只「野怪」（阵营 N），自成第三阵营。
野怪平时随机游荡并阻挡格子；一旦被攻击、或有单位走到它相邻格，就会激怒并锁定追杀挑衅者，直到目标死亡。
击杀野怪不计入胜负，它们在每回合结束时统一行动，并使用独立随机数流，不影响双方原有平衡。
decideTurn 的 ctx 新增 neutralUnits 字段，agent 可读取野怪信息并据此走位与决策。

en.title: Neutral monsters arrive
items: 8–12 neutral "monsters" (faction N) now spawn in the middle neutral columns as a third faction.
Monsters wander and block cells while passive; the moment they are attacked or a unit steps adjacent, they enrage and hunt whoever provoked them until that target dies.
Killing monsters never counts toward victory. They act once at end of round on a dedicated RNG stream, so player balance is unchanged.
decideTurn's ctx gains a neutralUnits field, so agents can read monsters and factor them into movement and decisions.

zh.title: 先手硬币 & 竞技场重制
items: 每局开局抛硬币决定先手方：先手方每回合先行动，后手方获得 +10 金币补偿，回放页会展示硬币结果。
竞技场界面全面重做，并重新平衡了内置 bot 与 ELO 计算。
回放页支持自动播放，并在战斗结束后自动滚动到棋盘。

en.title: First-mover coin flip & arena overhaul
items: Each match opens with a coin flip for the first mover: the winner acts first every round, the second mover gets +10 gold to compensate, and the replay page shows the result.
The arena UI was fully reworked, with rebalanced built-in bots and ELO scoring.
The replay page now autoplays and scrolls to the board after a battle.

zh.title: 被动技能 & 新兵种工兵
items: 移除主动技能系统，改为各兵种自带被动（骑士受伤减半、法师溅射、牧师治疗、长矛穿刺等）。
新增第六个兵种「工兵」。
新增平局检测：长时间毫无进展的对局会提前结束，按剩余兵力强度裁决，不再硬耗到回合上限。

en.title: Passive abilities & the new Engineer
items: The active-skill system is gone — every unit now has a built-in passive (knight half-damage, mage splash, priest heal, spear pierce, and so on).
Added a sixth unit type: the Engineer.
Added stalemate detection: matches with no progress for many turns end early and are decided on remaining army strength, instead of grinding to the turn cap.

zh.title: 经济与棋盘重做
items: 经济系统重做：用金币购买军队、攻击不再消耗行动点，购买窗口为前 10 回合。
棋盘定为 16×12，每回合固定 +10 金币收入，单位「强度」按购买成本计算。
挑战对手被限制在与自己分数 ±10% 的区间内，匹配更公平。

en.title: Economy & board redesign
items: Reworked economy: buy your army with gold, attacks no longer cost action points, and the buy window is the first 10 turns.
The board is fixed at 16×12 with a flat +10 gold/turn income, and unit "strength" is measured by purchase cost.
Challenges are restricted to opponents within ±10% of your score for fairer matchmaking.
